run_Trainer_evaluation: run the Trainer to evaluate a pretrained model on ImageNet validation set and return top1 and top5 accuracy
create_TrainerState_checkpoint: create a TrainerState checkpoint by saving the model state dict to a file for later resumption
load_TrainerState_from_checkpoint: load a TrainerState from an existing checkpoint file to resume model evaluation
compute_accuracy_sp_topk: compute the precision at k for specified topk values given model output and target labels
track_HistoryMeter_metrics: track running average metrics with full precision summation using HistoryMeter to avoid floating point errors
